verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken layout. The cross is blown up into a huge, blurry raster that competes with the headline. The dates line is tiny and jammed against the headline's right edge. 'Worship & Bible Study' floats beside the cross with no shared alignment. The middle text column is cramped while the headline and illustration crowd their sides. A's cross is slightly larger and its illustration runs almost to the right edge. B leaves a little more right margin and has a marginally smaller cross, so it is only barely better.
